description: 과학기술정보통신부_공동활용서비스 연구시설 장비 정보 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부. 공동활용서비스가 가능한 전국의 연구시설 장비 정보를 수집하고 예약서비스를 제공하여 연구자 편익 증대 및 R&D 효율화에 기여하기 위하여 생성된 API입니다. 제공 API(주요 응답항목) - 국가연구시설장비정보연계(모델, 주시설장비, 구축과제, 기관, 설치장소, 우편번호, 심의정보, 정보유효성, 시설장비)... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부. Its tags are 기계, 기타 기계, 달리 분류되지 않는 기계, 연구시설장비정보, 연구장비. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
